newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia cut.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said on Wednesday it had downgraded its rating for Argentina's Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires SA to neutral from attractive.
-- "Our bet, since the beginning of the year, for Banco de Galicia has worked well with year-to-date gains of 28.4 percent," analyst Alberto Sanchez wrote in a report.

-- "This is approximately 10 points above the Merval's (the Buenos Aires stock exchange) performance. However, the most recent impressive rally of 20 percent since Oct 25 (24 percent for those that purchased the new shares issued on Nov 1, 1996) makes us believe that the banks is reaching full valuation in the short term."
-- He added, "... We think the stock, over the next six months, is fully valued with a target price for mid-1997 of $23 (3.3 percent upside from now)."
-- The company's American Depositary Receipt was trading up 15/64 to 22-1/2 in New York.
